title: Reproducing a published result
description: Extracting the exact setup of a claim, reproducing it at small scale over many seeds, comparing with the reported number using confidence intervals and tolerances, documenting deviations, and diagnosing why reproductions fail.

title: Designing and evaluating original experiments
description: From research question to hypothesis, controls and baselines; power and sample size; multiple comparisons (Bonferroni, Benjamini-Hochberg); ablation grids and interactions; pre-registration, p-hacking and honest reporting of negative results.
